nodes.title: BOM spend, baseline and pessimistic
nodes.equation: spend = sum(qty x unit) x (1 + tax) + shipping + FAA fee (+ adders, pessimistic prices); lines in team/I1/build_bom.py LINES

nodes.title: Bottom-up minus R2-bridge (pessimistic spend)
nodes.equation: delta = spend_pess(bottom-up) - [1687.01 (R2) + sum(R3 line deltas) x (1 + tax)]

nodes.title: Reserve at order, pessimistic and baseline
All-in spend if every gated BOM line (X07, X08, X10, X12) were also bought
nodes.equation: all-in spend = spend + gated lines x (1 + tax); reserve = budget - spend

nodes.title: New bought ground-test purchase (line G12)
nodes.equation: sum of BOM lines with group 'groundtest', pre-tax

nodes.title: BOM spend at order, baseline
nodes.how: Re-run build_bom.py after re-pricing each line on the day of the order; compare with the order confirmations.

nodes.title: BOM spend at order, pessimistic
nodes.how: Same lines at list price plus the DECISION section 9 adders; CL-I1-BRIDGE-DELTA must be 0.

nodes.title: Bottom-up minus R2 bridge (USD)
nodes.how: Non-zero means a BOM line changed without the bridge table in build_bom.py bridge() being updated.

nodes.title: Pessimistic reserve at order
nodes.how: 2 000 minus CL-I1-SPEND-PESS must be >= 309 (one class-S crash incl. tax). On the day: re-price every CARRY line.

nodes.title: Baseline reserve at order
nodes.how: 2 000 minus CL-I1-SPEND-BASE must be >= 150 (planned reserve, P2).

nodes.title: Pessimistic reserve if the gated lines X07 and X08 were also bought
nodes.how: 2 000 minus the all-in pessimistic spend. Information, not a gate: the committed order holds >= 309 by deferring X07 and X08 until their gate passes. Below 309 means every gated line cannot be bought on pessimistic numbers.

nodes.title: New bought ground-test purchase, pre-tax (USD)
nodes.how: D-39: at most $20 is bought new for ground test (G12 only); gauges G13 are CL-I1-GROUNDTEST-WITH-GAUGES. The 20 kgf cell kit G06 ($17.97) was already in the baseline.

nodes.title: New ground-test purchases incl. the two fin-proof strain gauges G13, pre-tax (USD)
nodes.how: G12 $17.00 (D-39 line, limit 20) + G13 $9.00 (CR-C4-38): $26.00 is $6 above the D-39 line. Information for A1, who owns the decision; the gauges are in the pessimistic spend.

nodes.title: Confirm the pack connector and lead gauge before ordering
nodes.procedure: Before the pack order: ask the seller for the discharge-lead gauge (needs >= 10 AWG, F1 CL-F1-PACKLEAD-RISE) and confirm EC5 / 4S / 6500 / hard case / 2 packs in the cart (D-64). 12 AWG: stop, tell E2 and F1. Do not order the 130C XT60 SKU (680 g, 12 AWG). On arrival: measure the lead conductor with calipers, weigh both packs (accept <= 560 g each, CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT, one line since D-95).

nodes.title: Re-read the six listings before each order
nodes.procedure: On 20 Nov and 15 Dec open: LANRC ASIN B0D2HS4Y4J, SunnySky X3108S, Ovonic 2-pack (connector, lead gauge, mass, price), Aloft tube, APC 11x5.5MR/11x4.5MR; log price and stock in team/I1/listing_log.csv; re-run build_bom.py.

nodes.title: Jacobs staff answer the equipment questions (Maker Pass is drop-in access, no loans)
nodes.procedure: First Electronics Lab visit (before 20 Nov, with the safety training done): (a) confirm in the lab that flux and wick are at the soldering stations (else buy G10, gate X10) and that a multimeter reads K-type probes (else X09); (b) ask staff by email whether Jacobs allows hot-wire foam cutting or foam on the ShopBot (a yes would remove G11 and H05, $62.54 incl. tax); (c) confirm the Spring 2027 Maker Pass covers all four builders from 19 Jan. Jacobs does not lend equipment: the pass is in-lab access (jacobsinstitute.berkeley.edu/making-at-jacobs, checked 2026-11-13). File the reply in team/I1/borrow_confirmation.txt.

nodes.title: Weigh and inspect on arrival
nodes.procedure: Weigh each pack, motor, ESC and the Aloft tube; check the pack connector is XT60; give masses to A3 and E2 (pack_log.csv).
